testsuite.name: UC11 Password Functionality
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: A User has been created in iTrust2 .

step.actions: user: An existing user in the system may change their current password. The user is prompted to enter their current password, a new password, and a confirmation of their new password (by entering it again in a separate input field). If the user attempts to change their password to their current password, an error is thrown . If the input fields for 'new password' and 'confirm new password' are different, an error is thrown .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: Reset password
testcase.preconditions: A User has been created in iTrust2 .

step.actions: user: An existing user in the system may reset their password if they forgot their current password. The unauthenticated user is prompted to enter a valid user name for the system . A temporary password and a reset link will be sent to the email associated with this user. If no valid email is associated with the entered user, an error occurs. The user then may change their password, by entering the temporary password into the current password field during a password change . If the temporary password has expired, an error message is shown .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
